response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.observstation NOT IN (SELECT t2.observstation FROM telescopes t2 JOIN observatories o2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation WHERE t2.equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10
